datagroup: model_refresh_morning {
  sql_trigger: SELECT FLOOR(((TIMESTAMP_DIFF(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),'1970-01-01 00:00:00',SECOND)) - 60*60*6)/(60*60*24)) ;;
  max_cache_age: "6 hours"
}
